rationale: This mutation bridges the -$10,999 cash deficit by lifting the land-labor ceiling through synchronous expansion to 20-22 plots matched to 10-11 hands by Day 15-16, while keeping early-game cash velocity fluid via a two-tier liquidation threshold (>=5 items on Days 1-6, >=14 items post-Day 6 with a firm 0.84x floor). It accelerates hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding with a hard Day-18 planting cutoff that pivots late acreage to 3-day Carrots, enforces duration-feasibility gating on town shop orders to prevent dead capital, and eliminates transit latency through in-situ plot servicing (immediate harvest-and-water). Finally, it raises the Oracle glut trigger to >=0.60 and purges phantom livestock wheat reserves to maximize usable shed capacity.
